name: AYYES Forms – AI Contact Form Builder, Lead Forms, Survey, Quiz & SMTP Email Delivery
author: AYYES

sections.description:
AI Contact Form Builder with Built-in Lead Management

AYYES Forms is an AI-assisted WordPress contact form builder for creating responsive contact forms, lead forms, registration forms, application forms, feedback forms, multi-step forms, and other supported forms without writing code.

Use one workflow to build forms, store and manage leads, configure notifications and optional SMTP, check common form risks, and migrate supported forms safely.

Build forms. Protect leads. Check delivery. Migrate safely.

Why Choose AYYES AI Contact Form WordPress Builder?

AYYES Forms combines AI-assisted form creation, lead management, delivery tools, health checks, and migration in one WordPress workflow.

  • Build contact, lead, registration, feedback, and multi-step forms without code
  • Use optional AI to draft forms, then review and edit manually
  • Create responsive layouts with conditional logic, uploads, signatures, confirmations, and redirects
  • Manage leads with statuses, owners, notes, tags, and exports
  • Check risks with Form Health Check and Pre-Publish Check
  • Use WordPress mail or optional SMTP with tests and delivery logs
  • Migrate supported Contact Form 7, WPForms, and Fluent Forms with dry-run verification

Drag-and-Drop WordPress Contact Form Builder

Create forms visually with standard and advanced fields, validation, responsive columns, page breaks, multi-step layouts, conditional logic, confirmations, redirects, file uploads, signatures, styling controls, and desktop/tablet/mobile previews.

AI-Assisted Form Creation

Start with a blank form or describe the form you want. When the optional AI workflow is enabled, AYYES Forms can prepare an editable draft with supported fields, steps, notifications, confirmations, responsive columns, and logic. Preview, edit, regenerate, or continue manually before approval.

Form Health Check and Pre-Publish Check

The read-only Form Health Check helps identify common form and lost-lead risks without automatically changing a live form. It can review notification settings, submission storage, spam protection, required fields, confirmations, redirects, failed submissions, mobile layout, accessibility, inactive integrations, and unanswered leads.

The Pre-publish Check can flag common setup issues before a form goes live. Administrators decide what to change.

WordPress Email Notifications and SMTP

Use the default WordPress mail system or optional custom SMTP. Configure admin and user notifications, multiple notifications per form, connection testing, test emails, and delivery logs. An Accepted status means the configured mail system accepted the request; it does not guarantee inbox placement.

Built-In WordPress Lead Management

When lead storage is enabled, supported submissions are saved in WordPress before notification processing. View, search, filter, assign status or owner, add notes and tags, record lead value, review submission details, and export lead information.

Switching from Another WordPress Form Plugin?

AYYES Forms includes guided migration for supported forms from Contact Form 7, WPForms, and Fluent Forms. The workflow can include form detection, dry-run preview, field mapping, supported-setting import, verification, placement replacement, migration reports, and rollback options where supported.

Always review the migration report and test the imported form before removing the original plugin.

Compare AYYES Forms with Popular WordPress Form Plugins

Different plugins serve different workflows. AYYES Forms focuses on combining form creation, Form Health Check, email-delivery diagnostics, lead management, and supported migration in one workflow.

  • Contact Form 7 – established contact-form workflow. AYYES emphasizes visual building, stored leads, health checks, and guided migration.
  • WPForms – broad AI/drag-and-drop ecosystem with templates, payments, surveys, and add-ons. AYYES emphasizes form health, delivery diagnostics, lead management, and migration together.
  • Fluent Forms – broad builder with AI, conditional logic, conversational forms, reporting, and integrations. AYYES emphasizes diagnostics plus a lead/delivery/migration workflow.
  • Forminator – visual forms plus polls, quizzes, calculations, and payments. AYYES emphasizes business forms, diagnostics, lead handling, and migration.
  • Ninja Forms – drag-and-drop forms, submissions, calculations, and extensions. AYYES emphasizes an integrated health/delivery/lead workflow.
  • SureForms – Gutenberg-native AI form creation with payments and advanced form types. AYYES emphasizes dedicated health checks, lead management, delivery tools, and migration.
  • MetForm – Elementor-focused form building. AYYES emphasizes a dedicated WordPress form workflow with health, delivery, and lead tools.
  • Formidable Forms – advanced forms, calculators, surveys, and data views. AYYES emphasizes lead capture, diagnostics, and migration.
  • WS Form LITE – advanced drag-and-drop forms, styling, accessibility, and submission tools. AYYES emphasizes health checks, delivery diagnostics, and migration.

Feature availability varies by plugin edition and can change. Compare current WordPress.org listings and documentation before choosing a form plugin.

Spam Protection and Privacy

Supported spam-protection, rate-limiting, consent, and tracking controls are available. Administrators remain responsible for configuration, privacy notices, retention settings, and legal compliance.

Documentation and Resources

  • AYYES Forms: https://ayyes.com/wordpress/ayyes-forms/
  • AYYES Help Center: https://ayyes.com/help/
  • Privacy Policy: https://ayyes.com/legal-notices/privacy-policy/
  • Terms of Service: https://ayyes.com/legal-notices/terms-of-service/

External Services

AYYES Forms works as a manual form builder without external AI. If an administrator intentionally uses an AI feature requiring external processing, information submitted for that AI request is sent to AYYES infrastructure to generate or improve the form. Review the service information, Privacy Policy, and Terms before enabling external AI processing.

Service: https://ayyes.com/wordpress/ayyes-forms/
Privacy Policy: https://ayyes.com/legal-notices/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://ayyes.com/legal-notices/terms-of-service/

Privacy

Form submissions may contain personal data and can be stored in the site’s WordPress database when lead storage is enabled. Site administrators are responsible for appropriate notices, consent, retention practices, and applicable privacy requirements.

Optional external AI processing is used only when an administrator intentionally enables and uses an AI feature that requires the AYYES service.

  4. Preview and test the form before publishing.
sections.faq:
What is AYYES Forms?

An AI-assisted drag-and-drop WordPress form builder with responsive forms, notifications, optional SMTP, lead management, Form Health Check, and guided migration tools.

What forms can I build?

Contact, lead, registration, application, feedback, multi-step, file-upload, and other supported WordPress forms.

Do I need AI to use AYYES Forms?

No. Manual form building and editing remain available without the optional AI service.

Will form submissions be saved?

Yes, when lead storage is enabled. Supported submissions are saved in WordPress before notification processing.

Does email work without SMTP?

Yes. AYYES Forms can use the default WordPress mail system; optional SMTP, connection testing, and test delivery are available when needed.

Can I migrate an existing form?

AYYES Forms provides guided migration for supported forms from Contact Form 7, WPForms, and Fluent Forms. Review the dry run and migration report and test the imported form before removing the original plugin.

Does the AI generator send data outside WordPress?

Only when an administrator intentionally uses an AI feature that requires the AYYES external service. Manual form building does not require external AI processing.

Are payments included in version 1.0.0?

No. Production payment workflows for Stripe, PayPal, and Square are not active features of version 1.0.0.

Does AYYES Forms guarantee email delivery or legal compliance?

No. Inbox placement depends on the hosting and email environment, and legal compliance remains the website owner’s responsibility.
